description: WRITE: removes a webhook from a form; the receiving URL stops getting new entries immediately. Needs the webhook hash returned by wufoo_add_webhook (Wufoo has no endpoint to list webhooks). Wufoo: DELETE /forms/{identifier}/webhooks/{webhookHash}.json.

form.description: Form identifier: its permanent hash (e.g. s1afea8b1vk0jf7) or its URL title (e.g. wufoo-api-example). See wufoo_list_forms.

name: wufoo_delete_webhook
title: Delete a webhook
